notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake and Archaeomancer enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Displace to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
